basis: 20 vocations, 6 multidisciplinary combinations, one causal-model capstone

cards.question: Which observables remain invariant across the original 108-cycle and viable transformations?
cards.test: Define a finite catalogue of symbol-count, neighborhood, D4, translation and class-phase invariants on the physical 66-residue observation mask; compare across grammars without using their imputed completions as input.
cards.control: Exact within-class/frame permutation and observed-mask matched null; account for post-hoc selection of symmetry group.
cards.discriminator: A predeclared nontrivial invariant with predictive consequences on currently unseen residues that is exceptional under its matched null.
cards.gate: No new sticker required; freeze tested transformation list before scoring.
cards.stop: Stop after fixed catalogue and matched-null result; retain null even if no invariant survives.

cards.question: Does the code carry a rhythmic or phrase structure rather than single-glyph semantics?
cards.test: Analyze event gaps, phrase boundaries, self-similar motifs and run-length intervals under serial order; optionally compare as symbolic percussion against source-native printer timing if authentic packet times exist.
cards.control: Match class-by-class glyph census, H108 cycle, run counts and multiple tested meters; use known direct Morse/run grammar negatives as baselines.
cards.discriminator: One source-cued meter/phrase grammar yields held-out prediction or a specific historically authentic timing receiver.
cards.gate: Timing interpretation remains conditional unless original source supplies durations.
cards.stop: Stop after a bounded meter set; avoid sound-alike or music-fitting output claims.

cards.question: Are existing owner/media chains hiding a missed primary observation?
cards.test: Build claim→owner→physical edition→source media→resale chain for unresolved priority cases; locate date contradictions, aliases, archived originals and previously uninspected frames.
cards.control: Reconcile full community numbered/lost/unknown entries, not just names; deduplicate reuploads; preserve source loss and provider blocks.
cards.discriminator: A new original image/primary testimony or a corrected provenance contradiction, never an inferred sticker.
cards.gate: Do not contact owners automatically; prefer archived primary material and handoff-ready source.
cards.stop: Stop per case at original-byte exhaustion, documented block or verified reconciliation; record negatives.

cards.question: Are serial class, tile placement and 108-foldout coordinates distinct but interoperating grids?
cards.test: Enumerate physically meaningful 9×12,12×9,3×3×12 and registered nine-class coordinate maps, explicitly typing class vs occurrence coordinates.
cards.control: Apply exact photograph/assembly anchors; same-mask geometry-preserving shuffled nulls; do not use a fitted transformation as an independent cue.
cards.discriminator: A source-native registration that fixes an otherwise free map or provides a frozen prediction.
cards.gate: Reconstruct only layouts compatible with original panel dimensions.
cards.stop: Stop if only arbitrary affine/D4 degrees of freedom remain or old fixed null is reproduced.

cards.question: Which new observation or historical source most efficiently separates the live hypotheses?
cards.test: Re-rank 50/54/93, 82/84/94/102 and other disagreements by expected information gain jointly with realistic evidence-recovery probability and research cost; show sensitivity to priors.
cards.control: Compare to plain disagreement count, class-balanced baseline and prior acquisition rankings; keep correlated models in one dependence cluster.
cards.discriminator: A defensible top-10 acquisition/search order with exact conditional outcomes and trigger for revision.
cards.gate: Do not presume a new sticker is necessary; include archived consumer/source recovery as actions.
cards.stop: Freeze input model families and priors; stop when ranking insensitive to further low-confidence assumptions.

cards.question: Which layers interact nonadditively to reveal an operation?
cards.test: Ablate and factorially recombine observed glyph, serial, A-I class, background artwork and authentic external source parameters using typed transformations only.
cards.control: Additive layer baseline, source/label-shuffled interactions and full attempted-combination denominator; protect fitted operations from test data.
cards.discriminator: An interaction whose extra constraint predicts a new observation or registers to an independently authenticated consumer.
cards.gate: First restrict combinations to type-compatible operations and original artifacts.
cards.stop: Stop initial pilot at pairwise plus preselected triple combinations; no unfettered transform zoo.

cards.question: Which frequently repeated premises collapse under adversarial cross-examination?
cards.test: Maintain a two-sided claim brief for H108, exact endpoint, carrier purpose, 81/27, manufacturing independence and alleged external consumers; articulate strongest rival and decisive contradiction.
cards.control: Use primary observations only and seek negative instances; distinguish model consequence from independent premise.
cards.discriminator: A narrowed assumption stack, explicit counterfactuals and ranked tests resolving the highest-stakes uncertainty.
cards.gate: Existing exact falsifications are immutable; no blanket claim that one negative rejects all variants.
cards.stop: Stop each brief with a source/observation that could change the verdict; never close solely for lack of source.

cards.question: What could be decoded despite 42 currently unseen H108 positions?
cards.test: Simulate random and mechanism-correlated erasures on observed symbols; compare recovery, ambiguity and human-readable output feasibility across minimal grammars.
cards.control: Training-only census majority, exact conditional-completion baseline, predeclared erasure regimes; report coverage and correctness separately.
cards.discriminator: A decoder with stable bounded output under observed-mask omissions without imputing physical observations.
cards.gate: Treat missingness as nonrandom possible; no assumed future sticker.
cards.stop: Stop if purported erasure resistance disappears on complete A-I class withholding.
cards.progress_note: Exact minimal H108+81/27 binary-sector erasure grammar retains 2^42 completions, with 27 unknown body and 15 unknown tail sites; original redundancy/consumer operation unresolved.

cards.question: Could the printed marks function literally as punctuation, commands or direction cues?
cards.test: Enumerate a small typed glyph-grammar table: slash/path/division, dash/continuation/subtraction, dot/point/termination, and test with authentic Terminal41/lever/user interfaces.
cards.control: Grammar-free token permutations, known direct-password failure, explicit costs for added syntax and arbitrary word choice.
cards.discriminator: One operation naturally accepted by a verified contemporary interface or independent instructions that specify glyph roles.
cards.gate: Treat jokes/linguistic analogies only as candidate generators, not evidence.
cards.stop: Cap to source-attested interfaces and two predeclared candidate parsers per type.

cards.question: Is the glyph sequence output of a conventional/ternary/finite-state family rather than an image?
cards.test: Score compact ternary, variable-length, transposition, key-schedule and finite-state coder families on the original common observed mask and known cross-puzzle sources.
cards.control: Retain published negative Trifid/Morse results; nested family selection corrections, held-out physical coverage and balanced symbol null.
cards.discriminator: A specified low-complexity decoder that beats matched controls and predicts a new symbol or original reader response.
cards.gate: Do not repeat already closed direct ciphers without changed operator/cue.
cards.stop: Stop on saturation of bounded code family without independent payload evidence.

cards.question: Which differential diagnosis explains all current observations with least assumption debt?
cards.test: Create likelihood/constraint table for message-first, structure-first, manufacturing-metadata, interaction-first, and hybrid models; separate nested hypotheses and observation reliability.
cards.control: Sensitivity to prior weights, correlated evidence clusters and disputed records; do not multiply same-source evidence.
cards.discriminator: A decision table identifying next high-value discriminator, not unearned numeric probability of solution.
cards.gate: Use conditional probabilities only where defensible; otherwise ordinal likelihood.
cards.stop: Stop after falsifier/next-evidence column exists for every model.

cards.question: What solution path was actually feasible to a 2019–2020 purchaser?
cards.test: Build three chronological player walkthroughs (one CE, pooled CEs, ARG-aware player), documenting cues, necessary stickers and feedback points at release-time availability.
cards.control: Compare to verified prior ARG affordances and no-further-endgame/null story; reject later archival discoveries as contemporary clues.
cards.discriminator: A source-specific, human-feasible step with an observable feedback/consumer absent from current story.
cards.gate: Do not grant historical players modern repo data or post-release archives.
cards.stop: Stop when each walkthrough identifies exact missing historical cue or demonstrates a complete conditional path.
cards.progress_note: Historical one-owner, pooled background, conditional foreground and null walkthroughs documented; independently fixed foreground receiving operation remains missing.

cards.question: What evidence could different holder groups supply with least friction?
cards.test: Build consent-respecting request variants for sellers, current owners, old purchasers, unboxers, archivists, retailers and manufacturing partners; distinguish serial, tile, print sheet and packaging evidence.
cards.control: Compare candidate requests against documented past contacts; prevent duplicate unsolicited outreach or privacy escalation.
cards.discriminator: A practical reviewed Raezores handoff/request template or independently archived original photo.
cards.gate: No messages sent; only user/community-mediated opt-in outreach.
cards.stop: Stop at finished source-specific templates and source/owner reconciliation.

cards.question: Are printer strings and sticker fragments homologous under bounded transformations?
cards.test: Align motifs under rotations, inversions, block swaps and local insertions using original printer reference corpora; group by proven source/time family.
cards.control: Source-specific alphabet frequency and motif-preserving synthetic controls, correct for scanning many alignments.
cards.discriminator: A replicated correspondence with independently prescribed orientation or a novel source-linked prediction.
cards.gate: Do not assume direct Xbox 36-row match after its documented rejection.
cards.stop: Cap alignment families and count all attempted shifts/transforms.

cards.question: Is meaningful information concealed in occlusion, negative space or attention framing?
cards.test: Examine original sticker images for symbol-mask occlusion, multiple-exposure background recovery, sparse perimeter pixels and angle/lighting effects.
cards.control: Use full native original photo support masks, synthetic occlusion nulls and independent same-class observations; no inpainting-as-observation.
cards.discriminator: New physically visible stroke/registration feature reproducible across independently sourced originals.
cards.gate: Original-byte provenance and per-pixel observed support required.
cards.stop: Stop once each of nine classes has an observability/coverage map and source-specific evidence needs.

cards.question: What generator most economically explains serial, A-I cycle and foreground glyph assignment?
cards.test: Specify distinct generative pipelines (serial→art→glyph; artwork sheet→serial; independent glyph stream; batching) and test implied conditional independences on the 84-record physical ledger.
cards.control: Use observed sticker records only; manufacturing/copy-number uncertainty; frame-conditional shuffle and model-complexity penalty.
cards.discriminator: Pipeline predicts observed cross-run statistical property that existing H108 period model does not trivially imply.
cards.gate: Never interpret derived machine states as print-production measurements.
cards.stop: Stop after explicit falsifiable signatures for at least three pipelines and exact data-limited result.
cards.progress_note: Completed first bounded deterministic-address and print-history nonidentifiability pilot; original print-job constraint remains outstanding.

cards.question: Which physical production and custody traces establish the order of printing/numbering/packing?
cards.test: Audit contemporary iam8bit/Playdead marketing, packaging photographs, printing artifacts and batch/label stock; seek evidence of production stage boundaries.
cards.control: Distinguish original primary media from mockups, later reproductions and inferred runs; preserve ambiguous dates.
cards.discriminator: A dated primary production cue discriminating whether serial, glyph and background were assigned together.
cards.gate: No destructive inspection; use public/permissioned originals only.
cards.stop: Stop documentary pass after source/capture matrix and explicit unresolved physical measurements.

cards.question: Where does expected recoverable evidence per unit search cost remain high?
cards.test: Build a platform×locale×era search coverage and failure map; use known-positive blind recall, censored pages, duplicate chains and image quality to choose next bounded searches.
cards.control: Provider-block censoring, author/post-level exact gold, original-media retrieval and lead novelty separately; forbid 28k-task scaling before pilot recall.
cards.discriminator: Ranked consent-compliant 12-query and 48-image pilot with measured source-level recall/false prompts and complete failure waterfall.
cards.gate: Actual provider queries require authorized opt-in; offline audit can run now.
cards.stop: Stop at exact source recall and review metrics before wide deployment.

cards.question: What narrative setup/payoff would explain the sticker's role in the ARG chronology?
cards.test: Assemble a source-dated dependency graph of game printer, CE nine-piece URL, Terminal41, cover and later releases; write competing minimally speculative storylines.
cards.control: No-further-endgame and manufacturing-only stories as equal controls; contemporaneous evidence only for original intention.
cards.discriminator: A previously overlooked dependency or independently archived clue that predicts next puzzle function.
cards.gate: Do not award points for story elegance; missing endpoints stay missing.
cards.stop: Stop when all storyline edges are typed observed/attested/invented and a source retrieval could decide.

cards.question: Are the marks instructions for a physical alignment, fold, slide or stencil?
cards.test: Use true-scale A-I source masters and physical CE layout to test a limited family of overlay, rotation, masking, sliding-window and fold mechanisms.
cards.control: Rigid source-provided anchors, paper support masks, fixed D4 comparisons and same-source fabricated-image controls.
cards.discriminator: A fixed physical operation exposing source-native readable output and reproducible with printed mockups.
cards.gate: Do not infer poster/sticker physical identity from marketing photos.
cards.stop: Stop at preregistered geometric operations; park variants lacking full source masters.

cards.question: Can a common production graph explain observed invariants and material evidence?
cards.test: Combine PX-01,PX-16,PX-17 into a causal print-flow DAG; list conditional independences distinguishing generation order and later assembly.
cards.control: Observed serial/class/glyph only, no model completions; allow multiple equally fitting mechanisms.
cards.discriminator: An external print workflow artifact or frozen conditional prediction differentiating at least two production DAGs.
cards.gate: Production links conditional until original manufacturing evidence appears.
cards.stop: Stop once evidence sufficiency table and next distinct signature are documented.
cards.progress_note: Constructed rival preprint/on-demand/shuffled-packout DAGs, observational-equivalence proof and independent source triggers; still needs authentic print-layer or packout records.

cards.question: Is there a reproducible sequence grammar across sticker and printer corpora?
cards.test: Integrate PX-02,PX-10,PX-14 to compare metrical, alignment and automata languages using shared held-out and null protocol.
cards.control: Source-aware alphabet/motif shuffle, best-of-family correction and prior direct-Morse negatives.
cards.discriminator: A single parsimonious family predicts unseen data under more than one source corpus.
cards.gate: Different ARG corpora may encode different purposes; do not force shared plaintext.
cards.stop: Stop after joint family leaderboard and dependence-corrected controls.

cards.question: Does a physical registration operation reveal what the symbol overlay hides?
cards.test: Integrate PX-04,PX-15,PX-20 with original photo masks, exact paper ratios, nine-class assembly and candidate source-native overlay.
cards.control: Use only authentic unfilled pixels, rigid transforms and independent same-class photographic controls.
cards.discriminator: A deterministic registration with reproducible visible readout, not alignment-optimized OCR.
cards.gate: Full-resolution source-native overlay artwork and registration anchors may need recovery.
cards.stop: Stop if free translations dominate or alleged letters depend on synthetic filled pixels.

cards.question: Which evidence families have systemic blind spots or contradictory assumptions?
cards.test: Join PX-03,PX-07,PX-11 to issue an adversarial claim/evidence dependency map and correct unresolved source contradictions.
cards.control: Independent claim grouping by source and observation; censored source treated unknown rather than absent.
cards.discriminator: A falsifier or new original source resolving a high-centrality assumption cluster.
cards.gate: No direct owner outreach and no implied Bayesian precision.
cards.stop: Stop after all active top assumptions have source links and counterclaims.

cards.question: What simplest original player action connects the three marks to a contemporary ARG consumer?
cards.test: Combine PX-09,PX-12,PX-19 in competing complete conditional walkthroughs, including a simple literal-instruction interpretation.
cards.control: Original-time source inventory, one-owner and community cases, no-endgame story; report invented bridges.
cards.discriminator: An independently attested source-native input or physical action completing a short human solve.
cards.gate: Do not claim the story itself is proof.
cards.stop: Stop with at least two rival step-by-step paths and exact missing cue.

cards.question: What next action maximizes information under permanently missing stickers and bounded discovery budgets?
cards.test: Combine PX-05,PX-08,PX-18 into cost-weighted value-of-information rankings across archive, new source retrieval and physically missing residues.
cards.control: Robust rank sensitivity to uncertain recoverability, correlated hypotheses and missing-not-at-random models.
cards.discriminator: A reproducible next-action queue with expected discrimination and honest provider/source limits.
cards.gate: Search activity does not count as successful acquisition.
cards.stop: Stop at a capacity-bounded priority schedule; update only when new coverage/evidence changes.

cards.question: Does the same observed record favor message-first, structure-first or interaction-first generation?
cards.test: Specify three generative DAGs: authored payload→cipher→labels; structural production→glyph sequence; player action→physical distribution. Separate observable consequences, human decoding procedure and downstream consumer for each.
cards.control: Equal evidence table, complexity prior sensitivity, complete-source/no-endgame baseline and explicit observational nonidentifiability.
cards.discriminator: A concrete independent experiment that separates at least two DAGs without preferring the incumbent decoder.
cards.gate: Models may be observationally equivalent; missing production records is an evidentiary limit.
cards.stop: Stop with at least one discriminating prediction or a precise nonidentifiability result.
cards.progress_note: Proved broad message/structure/interaction/null histories observationally nonidentifiable under unrestricted hidden choices; source-conditioned discriminators remain to execute.
